title: Store Quantities, Keep the Cell
description: Use powered preparation to make the colored Matrix Crystals. Place a Decomposer, Matter Drive and Material Synthesizer in a touching row, all owned by the same player. Insert a Cell into any Drive bay and supply FE to both processors.
The Cell stores actual substance quantities and stays in the Drive. Solids, liquids and gases share capacity. There is no individual inventory item for each element. ReMatter adds no generator.
